description:
Creates a dependency between two tasks and recalculates the dates. Types: FS (finish-to-start, default), SS (start-to-start), FF (finish-to-finish), SF (start-to-finish). Lag is in working days and can be negative (lead).
If the two tasks are already linked, the existing link's type and lag are replaced. A link that would create a cycle is rejected and nothing is saved. Requires write permission.

lagDays.description: Lag in working days, negative for a lead.

lagMinutes.description: Lag in working minutes. Takes precedence over lagDays.

projectId.description: Project id (uuid), as returned by planitude_list_projects.

successor.description: The task that depends on the predecessor.

name: planitude_link_tasks
title: Link two tasks
